label: Healthcare / FHIR Software Engineer
positioning: Healthcare software engineer combining full-stack web development with hands-on FHIR R4/R5, consent modeling, SMART on FHIR, FHIR Shorthand, Medplum, HAPI FHIR, and interoperability demonstration experience.
summaryInstructions: Lead with paid healthcare work across Midato Health, Arizona State University, and Shift Task Force.
Emphasize consent systems, FHIR modeling, SMART App Launch, EHR data exchange, and practitioner-facing workflows.
Treat CQL and CDS Hooks as current project evidence until deeper professional use exists.
Describe OAuth as implementation experience, not security expertise.
Do not claim HL7 v2, Epic/Cerner production integration, or terminology depth until evidence exists.

coverLetterStrategy.opening: Connect the employer's clinical workflow or interoperability problem to Fred's paid FHIR and consent experience.
avoid: Generic enthusiasm for healthcare without technical evidence
Claiming production EHR-vendor integration not personally completed
Calling research or demo systems production systems

resumeRules.includeProjectsWhen: Include the clinical reasoning demo or another current FHIR project to show recent hands-on work.
